bodies.name: Parlament ta' Malta (Parliament of Malta)
bodies.layout: Header has a small language-switcher/utility bar (Maltese flag icon link, 'Contact Us', 'Search') above a logo row showing the 'Parlament ta' Malta' wordmark linking home. Below that sits a mega-menu style horizontal nav with top-level items Home, Mr Speaker, About Parliament, Parliamentary Business, Committees/Delegations, Reference Material, Get Involved — each with deep multi-column dropdown flyouts listing sub-pages (e.g. Composition of Parliament, Standing Committees list, Acts of Parliament). The homepage hero is a rotating slideshow/carousel banner followed by a mission statement paragraph. Below the hero are widgetized dashboard blocks for 'Business before the House', live tables for Motions/Orders of the Day, a 'Follow Parliament' live-streaming panel, a Parliament TV schedule table, 'Latest activities of the Speaker' and 'Latest press releases' card grids, a Vacancies/Public Procurement two-column table section, and a sidebar Parliamentary Calendar widget. Footer is a thin utility bar with Privacy/Copyright/Disclaimer/Sitemap/Contact links plus social share icons and a copyright line.
ui_patterns: AngularJS templating artifacts visibly leaking into rendered markup when JS/data doesn't load, a classic legacy-gov-CMS symptom
Bilingual language toggle via small flag icon (mt/en) present on every page in the utility bar
Deeply nested multi-level dropdown mega-menu for menu reflecting parliamentary/legislative hierarchy
Legislature-numbered URL and content structure (e.g. '15th-leg') baked into permalinks
Live broadcast / TV schedule module embedded directly in the homepage
Standing error-boundary messages shown inline when widgets fail to load data
Committee and archive listings organized as long flat bulleted lists rather than cards
Downloadable/legal document links (Acts, Bills, Standing Orders) treated as first-class nav items

language_samples.original: The primary objective of this website is to promote Parliamentary openness by facilitating access to documents published by this Institution and by enabling the public to follow more closely what is going on in Parliament.

bodies.name: gov.mt (Central Government of Malta / Office of the Prime Minister portal)
bodies.layout: Site runs on Microsoft SharePoint (confirmed via meta generator tag) with a classic SharePoint ribbon/ARIA skip-link structure ('Skip Ribbon Commands', 'Skip to main content', accessibility toggles for 'more accessible mode' and 'Turn off Animations'). Header row shows a text-zoom control (A A A), the 'gov.mt' wordmark plus a linked 'servizz' logo to the public-service portal, and a horizontal quicklinks nav: Dħul (Home), Avvenimenti (Events/Life Events), Dwar Malta (About Malta), Fittex (Search), Il-Gvern (The Government, with sub-items for Department of Information, Government Gazette, Media in Malta, Press Releases, Ministries and Entities), Public Consultation, and Servizzi u Informazzjoni (Services and Information). Below the nav is a full-width head-banner image and an emblem/coat-of-arms graphic block, followed by a grid of icon tiles linking out to service categories. The page defaults to the Maltese-language version at /mt/Pages/home.aspx unless an English path is explicitly requested.
ui_patterns: Built on Microsoft SharePoint publishing infrastructure, giving it classic ribbon/ARIA skip-link markup uncommon on modern gov sites
Explicit accessibility toggles exposed in the chrome itself: 'Turn on more accessible mode' and 'Turn off Animations'
Font-size stepper control (A A A) for text scaling, a hallmark of older public-sector accessibility compliance
JavaScript-gated content warning shown verbatim in markup indicating heavy client-side rendering of search/quicklinks
Maltese set as the default locale (redirects bare URL to /mt/Pages/home.aspx) with English as an alternate path
Government emblem/coat-of-arms rendered as a small favicon-adjacent image asset in the header
Portal-of-portals pattern: homepage mainly links out to satellite domains for actual tasks (servizz.gov.mt for services, recruitment.gov.mt for jobs, publicservice.gov.mt)
Deep breadcrumb trail rendered even on 404/error pages

language_samples.context: primary menu label for the homepage link

language_samples.original: Sorry. The page you are looking for does not exist. We may have removed a page to which you found a link, or you may have the wrong address for the page you are looking for.
If you are looking for information about a Ministry, department or any other public sector entity, start at the 'Ministries and Entities page' here.

bodies.name: Pulizija ta' Malta (Malta Police Force)
bodies.layout: A light grey-blue page with the police crest and the pulizija.gov.mt wordmark top-left, a text-size switcher (A A A) and a flat main menu: The Department, Services, Victim Support, Resources, Police Notices, Contact. Below sits a wide photographic carousel whose every slide says the same thing ('File A Police Report… CLICK HERE TO START'), then a row of public-service links (consultations, join, rate the service) and a tab strip: Welcome, File A Report, Tell Us About, Apply / Register, Thanks & Complaints. A long welcoming paragraph, a recruitment block and a press-release list follow.
ui_patterns: Carousel with three identical slides
Text-size switcher (A A A) in the header
Tab strip of citizen services under the hero
'Rate Our Service' satisfaction prompt
Recruitment block written in second person
Press releases list with dates
GDPR cookie banner offering Accept, Reject and Settings
